title: llms.txt Explained: Should Your Small Business Have One? (2026)
meta_title: llms.txt Explained: Does Your Business Need One? (2026)
meta_description: What llms.txt is, what Google and the research say about it in 2026, and what actually gets UK small businesses mentioned by ChatGPT and Gemini.

faq.a: A Markdown file at the root of a website that lists its key pages with short descriptions so AI tools can find them. It was proposed by Jeremy Howard of Answer.AI in 2024.
No. Google said in June 2026 that llms.txt has no effect on Search rankings or AI Overviews.
There's no public confirmation that ChatGPT's answer engine uses it. Studies of AI bot traffic show crawlers rarely request the file.

faq.q: Is llms.txt the same as robots.txt?
faq.a: No. robots.txt controls which crawlers can access your site; llms.txt only suggests which pages matter and can't block anything.

faq.q: What should I do instead to appear in AI answers?
faq.a: Allow AI crawlers, add structured data, write answer-first pages with clear prices, and earn reviews and mentions on trusted UK sites.
